stories.summary: Anthropic announced a $100 million investment to train 10,000 engineers, aimed at closing the enterprise AI talent gap. The source item carries only the headline, so further details of the program are not yet available.

sources.title: Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap

stories.title: Pinterest launches AI-powered Beauty Guides that turn hair and nail Pins into salon-ready plans
stories.summary: Pinterest has introduced AI-powered Beauty Guides that translate hair and nail Pins into salon terminology, along with estimated costs, appointment times, and maintenance needs, according to TechCrunch.

sources.title: Pinterest’s AI now turns beauty Pins into action plans
